ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Closed_Case_Requires_Contact ) , ISCHANGED( Status ) , ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed" ) , OR( ( NSP_Category__c = "Integra" ) , ( NSP_Category__c = "OrgPlus Software" ) , ( NSP_Category__c = "PerformSmart Software" ) , ( NSP_Category__c = "Time Wage Import" ) , ( NSP_Category__c = "XML" ) ) , ISBLANK( ContactId ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: At least one Contact is required to close this Case.
